items.title: Royal Demons
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Ruling the Nether doesn't mean you don't have class. Now you can live the sophisticated life amongst your fellow demons with this HD skin pack of demon royalty. With lavish tops and stunning suits, you're bound to make heads spin even more than usual.

- Includes 8 HD skins!
- A variety of lively outfits for the classiest demonic occasions
- By SmartPixel & Pathway Studios

items.title: Memory Mayhem
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Test your memory with this challenging minigame! You'll have 2 minutes to remember as much as you can from each detail-packed scene. But be careful! Answer incorrectly, and you'll find yourself face to face with a wave of deadly mobs.

- 50 questions
- Unlockable loot
- 4 unique memory scenes
- Bonus Challenge scene

items.title: Monster Mob Arena
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Fight hordes of dangerous monsters! Take on waves of enemy mobs until the boss arrives. Defeat the boss to collect resources. Use those materials to craft better weapons and armor.
- 37 custom monsters
- 7 themed waves
- Custom armor textures
- Roleplay and multiplayer fun

Hostile mobs attack bosses. How many zombies will it take to bring down the Scorpion King?

items.title: Car Crafter
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Craft realistic car parts and assemble a fully functional ride! Build an engine piece by piece using components such as the engine block, crankshaft, pistons, cylinder head, and more.
- 11 crafting recipes
- Optional quests and jobs
- Custom animations and sounds
- 16 colors
- 5 skins
- Survival, roleplay, or multiplayer fun

Begin your journey as a master mechanic!

items.title: Summer Rich Teens
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Summer is here! With these rich looking and cool skins, you'll be the coolest player at the beach, pool and street! Come on, don't miss the pool party!

+ 8 skins
+ Perfect for roleplay
+ Perfect for summer

items.title: Mob Hackers

These mobs are ready to hack anything that gets in their way! Watch out!

items.title: BEDWARS Classic!
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
The classic bedwars mini-game! Attack your opponents and defend your bed!

+ Lucky blocks

+ This world is made for multiplayer only

items.title: Fashion through the Ages
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Travel back in time...
Go all the way back to the 50s and 60s, or hop in on the newest trends with the 2010s and present popular skins!
Couple outfits that are perfect for all your favorite fashion styles!

+ 16 stylish skins!
+ 1 FREE skin: 1980s Wilson

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Designer Outfits
items.creator: Razzleberries

Fresh off the clothing racks, these designer outfits look good on anyone! Get them while they're in fashion!

- 8 skins
- Many different outfit designs so you can express your own unique style!

items.title: Sharks
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
With these shark skins you will surely not go unnoticed! Get these skins and show your friends which of you is the master of the seas! Guide your friends to discover the underwater temples with these shark skins!
+ 1 free skin
+ 10 shark skins

items.title: Fantasy Life
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Be an elf, orc, goblin, or even the rare triton! Have an adventure in Minecraft while playing as a fantasy character that suits you! 

- 8 skins!
- Inspired by classic role playing games!
- Pick from a wide selection of skin designs and choose one that represents you!

We are going to level with you all. We made farts in Minecraft. We have no idea why, but it is amazing!
